                model TEXT NOT NULL,
                provider TEXT NOT NULL,

        return self

            created_at=now,
            updated_at=now,
            status="active",
            model=model,
            provider=provider,
            metadata=metadata or {},

        conn = self._get_conn()
        with self._lock:

            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_status ON sessions(status);

        conn.commit()

        """Close the SQLite connection so Windows can release the DB file."""
        with self._lock:

                self._conn = None

        return self

    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb):

            created_at=now,
            updated_at=now,
            status="active",
            model=model,
            provider=provider,
            metadata=metadata or {},

        conn = self._get_conn()
        with self._lock:
